notes.title: Under 24 hours left on BIG HOPS' Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey folks,[/p][p][/p][h2]I'm writing to share BIG HOPS' Kickstarter is in its final 24 hours![/h2][p][/p][p]We've reached our funding goal, several stretch goals, and we're now pushing for two last stretch goals:[/p][h3]$55k - Photography Quests[/h3][p]You'll meet a weirdo NPC who asks you to snoop around and take pictures of interesting sights. Our team loves photography games like Pokemon Snap, Toem, and Penko Park so we're excited at maybe getting to add our own take on that genre. My designer brain is psyched for this Stretch Goal because it gives us the opportunity to recontextualize all our existing content by looking through this lens (lol) to see what things we've already made will be the most fun, interesting, and meaningful to take photos of.[/p][h3]$60k - PS5 & Xbox Series Ports[/h3][p]For games like BIG HOPS, being on many platforms is super important to our potential for success. We're already planning to be on Switch day 1 and reaching this stretch goal will give us enough money to ensure we end up on all 3 consoles as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]I want to give a heartfelt thanks to everyone here on Steam who has played our demo, wishlisted, and followed the game. And ESPECIALLY to those that have backed on Kickstarter already to help us finish BIG HOPS strong. [b]For the rest of you (and this is the last time I'll post about this here), please check out the Kickstarter and consider pledging to help us make this game as good as it can be:[/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/49bfd8212b2703a14879c256aa24c22426974539.png"][/img] [/p][p]Cheers,
Chris[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: BIG HOPS is 99% funded on Kickstarter
notes.notes: [p]Hey folks, Chris here![/p][p][/p][p]I'm the director of BIG HOPS.  I wanted to share an update on our progress getting the final touches of BIG HOPS funded on [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chriswade/big-hops"]Kickstarter[/url]![/p][p]After two weeks, we're about to hit our funding goal! That means we'll have the money we need for full VO, localization, QA, and getting started on PS5 and Xbox ports. We'll still be live for another 13 days, so if you're interested in helping us reach some stretch goals, getting early access to the full game, getting some digital rewards (artbook, OST, and design notes), or adding your hat, NPC, or challenge room design to the full game then hop over to Kickstarter:[/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/49bfd8212b2703a14879c256aa24c22426974539.png"][/img][/p][p]Don't expect this feed to get spammed with promotional links, think of this as a one time thing to celebrate our campaign imminently crossing 100%. To that end I'm going to share some details about the Red Desert area that immediately follows our demo:[/p][h3] [b]So what is BIG HOPS? What do you DO?[/b][/h3][p]BIG HOPS is an adventure first and foremost. The game takes place across four big Worlds: Hop's Forest, the Red Desert, the Ocean Rigs, and Shattered Mountain. You'll spend hours in each meeting dozens of characters, discovering new veggies and tongue interactions, and exploring carefully crafted worlds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/47c5cb47828a41ef5ac1a4873c2015cb95b74e83.png"][/img][/p][p]Each of these Worlds has a self contained story. You'll meet a main character, get involved in their drama, and try to help make things better while also seeking the Airship Part you need to get home.[/p][p]The story in each World offers a different perspective on the big thematic question running through Hop's adventure: [i]How do we balance individual pursuit with social responsibility?[/i] I won't say more about the subtext behind the game or Worlds, but that question underlies everything you do in the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Let's take a deeper look at the Red Desert (which follows the demo):[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/20a3fe95cb0a957da7e5c0e61d5325870add87fc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/75cf8ebd613d9c91bc0a0209afe28cfd4175b128.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/5196ef68564e2778f9b91daa347f887367cded18.png"][/img][/p][p]In the Red Desert, you'll find a hidden village of Rabbits where a giant sinkhole is threatening to swallow the town. The villagers are nervous and panicked, but the village council continues to reassure everyone that things are fine (they're not). There, a masked stranger invites you to spy on a supposed organized crime family to determine if they're behind the sinkhole.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/99e695bd6702b693245105ebbd0ea859869e1dde.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/31d1417812407606241539fce933c483ba8df7e2.png"][/img][/p][p]To reach the family hangout, Gulley HQ, you'll need to cross sand dunes and desert canyons using froggy parkour and a new Cactus Fruit that lets you scale walls by building tightropes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/7741e9ee79ec45b83965cb55dcb5f59e70f82951.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Eventually you'll find yourself deep underground in the sewers under Gulley HQ. You'll find gross Goo Balls that'll help you get around- make sure to handle with care, since they're one of our trickiest veggies to get a handle on.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/abf295f7afa482b274a4e547e0d8218839c6940a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To make it through the Sewers you'll have to use your tongue to pick locks, crawl through vents, and use a handy Camera Gadget to collect evidence proving who's behind the growing sinkhole.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/27fafbe623018a26480ea2ef5d2354a27cb22d27.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/95dbeb833d6a916058adc0e2d600be40780bc78b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Who IS behind the sinkhole? Why is this masked stranger leading you around? Is there even an Airship Part for you in all this mess?[/b] I'll leave these questions for you to figure out during your full playthrough when BIG HOPS releases later this year![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Chris[/p]

notes.title: BIG HOPS is on KICKSTARTER!
notes.notes:
Hey, Chris here!

I'm writing to share some big news! We're live on Kickstarter right now:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chriswade/big-hops][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/70b0948730bf353067010fd4664a3e828051d894.png[/img][/url]

We're already pretty close to finishing the game, but we need some finishing funds for VO, localization, QA, and console ports. Please check out the campaign and back our project if you like what you see!

This is also the biggest most in depth look at the game we've ever shared, so have a read through even if you aren't able to back the project.

Cheers,
Chris
